name: RevenueDog
description: Runs each morning to fetch the previous day's RevenueCat figures for an indie subscription app, alongside a conversion path it identifies from the app's own analytics. Assumes you already have both data sources wired up and a subscription product worth watching daily rather than weekly.

official.title: RevenueDog by Lex
official.description: A morning sales analyst for indie subscription apps. Pulls yesterday’s RevenueCat numbers plus a conversion path discovered from the app’s own Analytics...
